data.name: Asad
data.gender_notes: Asad is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic asad, 'lion'. Its root is أ-س-د (ʾ-s-d). A common Arabic given name. Asad is a Arabic name meaning “Lion”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Asad expresses “Lion”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Asad total 7, reducing to 7. Number 7 is associated with reflection, analysis and inner search.
